title: A box to make you feel ashamed.
text:
Update 2:
Order if you want to feel ashamed and think that vaginas are filthy disgusting monsters that need to be covered in perfume. The only "pampering" products I got in this last order were vagina wipes, vagina wash, and a vagina perfume spray.

Edit: (My third box was delayed because they did not put the full address on the box)
It says on amazon that the box is supposed to come with 3 products in addition to the pads, but I only got 2 in my first box. I also did not feel pampered by the products that I got in my first box. I got a feminine wash and hand sanitizing wipes. (What is with the sanitizing wipes in every box? I get its Covid times but come on, I want to feel pampered. Where are the face masks and heating patches? They would make much better regular items than sanitizing wipes.) I was thinking I would get comfort items, like their heating pads or face masks. I want things that make me feel better, not ashamed about normal feminine hygiene. I was also disappointed that the microthin liners (the only worthwhile liners) that were in my first box, were not in the second or third box. This makes 3 out of 3 boxes that had missing items. I must add that the second box was at least better. It had their snowballs, heat pads, and a sample of serum, along with some feminine wipes, of course.
I do like feeling prepared for my next period and feel there are enough pads/tampons (I have gotten both) to get me through my period. That said, there are too many liners. There are more than enough liners to wear one every day of the month.
The pads, unfortunately, do not stick to underwear of any material. Because of this, they are difficult to place. That said, once on, they surprisingly stay put. They just fall of every time you pull your underwear down. Yet, they are among the better pads I have tried. I honestly can't decide if I like this box or not. On one hand, getting the Pads Value Pack would get me similar things + more things I can actually use. On the other hand, this box is cheaper and there is the fun of the surprises. However, that an item is continuously missing from my boxes is a problem. It makes me not trust the company and makes me feel ripped off.
label: negative
